ext_data.CardText:
Can You Dig Up All the Fossil Cards?
Two million years ago, the first known Pokémon walked the earth. Scientists thought many were extinct like the dinosaurs because only fossils had been found-until now. A remote island has been discovered in the south seas, an island where the Pokémon fossils have come to life!
Dig in to the Fossil expansion and you'll find 47 new Pokémon cards for the official Pokémon trading card game. Trade with your friends, show off your favorites, and build decks from the random cards in this booster pack to customize a Pokémon theme deck or starter set. And most of all, play your friends in battle with the new Pokémon! Collect and play all the Fossil cards and you'll discover holographic cards with super attacks! Do you have the skills to become the world's number-one Pokémon Master? Dig in and find out!
New players should begin with the Pokémon two-player Starter Set. And collect both Pokémon: Fossil theme decks! Lock Down & Bodyguard!


• This booster pack contains 11 additional game cards for the trading card game.
Cards vary by pack. Packs may vary by products.
This booster pack contains 11 cards for Wizards of the Coast printed Fossil set.

ext_data.TCGplayer Tip: Released on October 10, 1999, Fossil is the 3rd main expansion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. 1st Edition Fossil cards and can be identified by the 1st Edition symbol in the center left of the card, and are generally considered rarer than Fossil cards from the Unlimited print run.

Play Mysterious Fossil as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Mysterious Fossil counts as a Pokemon (instead of a Trainer card).
